proud.definition: a. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride
proud.translation: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的

prouder.definition:
a feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride
s having or displaying great dignity or nobility

proudest.definition:
a feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride
s having or displaying great dignity or nobility
proudest.translation: a. 自豪的, 骄傲的；(因受表扬等而)感到光荣的, 引以为荣的

proudful.translation: a. <方>充满自豪的,非常骄傲的

proudhearted.translation: a. 骄傲的, 傲慢的

proudhon.definition: n. French socialist who argued that property is theft (1809-1865)
proudhon.translation:
n. (Proudhon)人名；(法)蒲鲁东
蒲鲁东

proudhonism.translation: n. (法国小资产阶级社会主义者、经济学家) 蒲鲁东的学说,蒲鲁东主义

proudly.definition: r. with pride; in a proud manner
proudly.translation: adv. 傲慢地, 自大地, 得意洋洋地

proudness.definition: n. The quality of being proud; pride.

proust's law.translation:
[化] 普鲁斯特定律
[医] 普劳斯特氏定律(定比定律)

proustian.definition: a. of or relating to or in the manner of Marcel Proust
proustian.translation: 普鲁士的, 普鲁斯特的（proust的形容词形式）

proustite.definition:
n. A sulphide of arsenic and silver of a beautiful
   cochineal-red color, occurring in rhombohedral crystals, and also
   massive; ruby silver.
